source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: Whenever one of your **EMPEROR'S CHILDREN** units is picked to fight having made a **Charge move** earlier in the turn, pick either **[[LETHAL HITS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/lethal-hits)** or else **[[SUSTAINED HITS 1]](vsdata:weapon-ability/sustained-hits)**; the melee weapons of its models have the chosen ability while those attacks are resolved.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 7 of 273 combat readings of Detachment rules (every record of the class not withheld otherwise, each time) wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.
